Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Concrete Dome Ceiling Hanging Pendant Chandelier Light Fixture - 8 x 8 x 30 Inches, Concrete and Metal
Colors: Concrete
Materials: Concrete Resin+Metal
This concrete dome-shaped pendant light is a great style addition for an urban setting. Its design will give your space an industrial feel, yet it's simple and understated enough to blend with more traditional styles, too. Product is hardwired (professional installation recommended). Modern, minimalist style Made of cement and metal A short stem works well on lower ceilings 8''Wx8''Dx30''H Product is hardwired (professional installation recommended)
